subject: Slot ownership and load equalization for backend interview panels
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Hiring Ops <hiring-ops@hire.redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Slot ownership and load equalization for backend interview panels

Hey team,

We have a visible pinch in the backend IC panel over the next three weeks: several scheduled screens + onsite slots are stacked around 10–2 PST and a few senior system-design slots have only one available interviewer. Hiring Ops flagged a risk of burnout and slower candidate flow.

Quick ask: can we reassign slot ownership so that we avoid double-booking the same folks for consecutive panels and create a small rotation of "floaters" to cover last-minute backfills? I attached a 1-page proposal (panel-balance-proposal.pdf) and an .ics with my suggested float shifts (panel-availability.ics).

Specific suggestions in the proposal:
- Define slot owners per weekday (Mon/Wed/Fri = Marcus primary, Tue/Thu = Lauren primary)
- Create a 2-person floater pool (preferably senior IC + EM) to cover same-day gaps
- Limit consecutive panels per owner to 3 (with 30m buffer)

If you agree, Hiring Ops can update the calendar and we can pilot for two weeks.

Available for a 20m sync this morning at 11:00 if useful.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Recruiting Partner, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Hiring Ops <hiring-ops@hire.redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slot ownership and load equalization for backend interview panels

On 18 May 2027, Soojin wrote:
> Quick ask: can we reassign slot ownership so that we avoid double-booking the same folks for consecutive panels and create a small rotation of "floaters" to cover last-minute backfills?

Thanks for flagging this, Soojin — I like the weekday ownership idea. I'm happy to be the Tue/Thu owner. A couple of notes:

- Marcus, can you confirm you have capacity on Mon/Wed/Fri for the next three weeks? I know you have a product rollout Wed afternoon.
- For floaters, I recommend Mina + one senior IC (I can ask around for volunteers). Mina, are you ok to be primary floater?
- We should add a policy in the calendar description: "If you cover a same-day backfill, flag the hiring thread & log coverage in the shared doc."

I can't do the 11:00 sync but can do 1:00pm PT.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Engineering Manager, Platform

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Hiring Ops <hiring-ops@hire.redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slot ownership and load equalization for backend interview panels

On Tue, May 18, 2027 at 9:32 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marcus, can you confirm you have capacity on Mon/Wed/Fri for the next three weeks?

Short answer: I can take Mon/Wed/Fri mornings (8:30–12:30) for the next two weeks but not the following week (on-call rotation that week). I'll swap with Laura if needed for that week.

About floaters: I prefer we avoid putting two EMs in the floater pair unless necessary — senior IC + EM balance better for design vs. execution questions. Mina is great as primary floater, Mina?

Also: recommend we reserve one afternoon block each week as "overflow" in case we need debriefs or extended interviews.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff Engineer, Core Infra

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Hiring Ops <hiring-ops@hire.redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slot ownership and load equalization for backend interview panels

I'm good to be floater the next two weeks — can cover lunchtime windows 11:30–14:30 PT most days. I can also take same-day fills but prefer at least 30m heads-up.

One operational ask: when someone covers, please add a short note in the thread with the candidate name and which slot you covered so Hiring Ops can keep panel records straight. Example: "Covered - Alex C. (System design) 2027-05-19 11:00 PT".

Happy to be on the 1:00 sync as well.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Software Engineer

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Hiring Ops <hiring-ops@hire.redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T16:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slot ownership and load equalization for backend interview panels

Thanks all — this looks good.

Agreement summary (to lock in):
- Mon/Wed/Fri mornings: Marcus primary (swap week requested Week of 2027-05-31)
- Tue/Thu: Lauren primary
- Floaters: Mina + one volunteer IC (Soojin to collect volunteers)
- Max consecutive panels per owner = 3 with 30m buffer
- Hiring Ops to create calendar roles + update calendar descriptions and add an "overflow" slot on Thursdays 14:00–16:00 PT.

Soojin: please confirm volunteer list by EOD Monday so Hiring Ops can publish the schedule.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
